SELECT
  MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress,
  MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM
  aka_name AS an
JOIN char_name AS chn ON an.person_id = chn.id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.person_id = an.person_id AND ci.note = '(voice)'
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = (SELECT company_id FROM movie_companies WHERE movie_id = ci.movie_id AND company_type_id = (SELECT id FROM company_type WHERE kind = 'production'))
JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = ci.movie_id AND cn.id = mc.company_id AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%' AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id AND mi.info IS NOT NULL AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mi.movie_id AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%' AND t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id AND n.gender ='f' AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.role ='actress' AND rt.id = ci.role_id
WHERE chn.id = ci.person_role_id
